people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today Yahweh has rescued Israel.”
translations.bsb: But Saul ordered, “No one shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.”
translations.kjv: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.
translations.asv: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day; for to-day Jehovah hath wrought deliverance in Israel.
